hero.title: Find safe parking while you are away from home
hero.subtitle: Book a driveway, garage or basement bay, checked by ParkNest, near your home for a day or a month. Own a spare spot? Host it and earn.

howItWorks.title: Search and compare
howItWorks.description: Enter location, vehicle and dates to see matching spots on the map.

howItWorks.title: Book and pay securely
howItWorks.description: Instant confirmation or host approval. We hold the spot while you pay.

howItWorks.title: Check in, park, check out
howItWorks.description: Get directions and entry instructions. The host is paid after check-out.
